question: estee lauder net sales this year
grading: (1) Identifies Estee Lauder (EL) and recognizes its fiscal year ends June 30. (2) Interprets 'this year' explicitly as fiscal, with dates: fiscal 2027 (July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027) is in progress and has no reported quarter yet as of 2026-10-03 (Q1 FY2027 ends Sept 30, 2026 and is not reported yet), so it gives the latest completed year, fiscal 2026 (July 1, 2025-June 30, 2026; reported Aug 19, 2026), clearly labelled, and/or the company's fiscal 2027 outlook labelled as guidance. (3) Net sales figure for FY2026 is cited. (4) Fail if it presents any FY2027 year-to-date or estimated net sales as actual, uses calendar 2026, or gives no fiscal dates.
answer: Estee Lauder: fiscal 2027 (from July 1, 2026) has nothing reported yet; gives fiscal 2026 net sales (year ended June 30, 2026; +5% reported, +3% organic) labelled as latest completed year, and may cite the FY2027 organic net sales growth outlook of 3% to 5%.

output.answer:
## The Estée Lauder Companies — Net Sales

**Most recent full fiscal year (FY2026, ended June 30, 2026): $15.05 billion**
- Up **5%** reported (3% organic) — the first return to growth after three consecutive annual declines
- Q4 FY2026 net sales: $3.63 billion, up 6%
- Growth across all geographic regions; fragrance was the standout (+10% organic)
- Operating margin improved to 5.2% from a (5.5)% loss in FY2025

**Prior fiscal year (FY2025): $14.33 billion** — down 8% year over year, with a net loss of ~$1.13 billion.

**Historical context (net sales):**
| Fiscal Year | Net Sales |
|---|---|
| 2026 | $15.05B |
| 2025 | $14.33B |
| 2024 | $15.61B |
| 2023 | $15.91B |
| 2022 | $17.74B (peak) |

**Guidance:** For FY2027, the company affirms organic net sales growth of 3%–5%.

Sources:
- [The Estée Lauder Companies Reports Fiscal 2026 Results (elcompanies.com)](https://www.elcompanies.com/en/news-and-media/newsroom/press-releases/2026/08-19-2026-110037466)
- [Estée Lauder Reports Fiscal 2025 Results (Nasdaq)](https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/estee-lauder-companies-reports-fiscal-2025-results-2025-08-20)
- [Estée Lauder revenue history (Macrotrends)](https://www.macrotrends.net/stocks/charts/EL/estee-lauder/revenue)
- [Estée Lauder sales rise to $15 billion in fiscal 2026 (Grafa)](https://grafa.com/en/news/united-states/estee-lauder-fiscal-2026-sales-rise-15-billion)

Note: Estée Lauder's fiscal year ends June 30, so "this year" depends on which fiscal period you mean — FY2026 ($15.05B) is the latest completed year.
